test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose ‘No improvement’ as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

The Blue House is **__practising it’s__** songs for the competition.
solution: The correct answer is '**practising its'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • "**It’s**" is a contraction of "**it is**" or "**it has**", but "**its**" (without an apostrophe) is needed here as we're indicating possession. • '**Practising its**' maintains the correct tense and uses the correct possessive form. • '**Practised it’s**' has a contraction error and an incorrect tense. • '**Practise its**' is incorrect due to the incorrect verb tense. Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3 ('practising its').** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • **"It’s"** एक संक्षिप्त रूप **(contraction)** है **"it is" या "it has"** का, लेकिन यहाँ** "its"** (अपॉस्ट्रोफी के बिना) की आवश्यकता है क्योंकि हम स्वामित्व (possession) दर्शा रहे हैं। • **'Practising its'** में सही tense और सही possessive form का प्रयोग हुआ है। • **'Practised it’s'** में contraction error और incorrect tense है। • **'Practise its'** सही नहीं है क्योंकि यहाँ verb tense गलत है। इसलिए, सही उत्तर है **Option 3 ('practising its').** 38:T4af, The incorrectly spelled word is option 3, "Agravate." The correct spelling is "Aggravate."
